source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This model can carry up to 6 models, all **LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY**, but no **ARTILLERY**, **EXOARMOUR**, **EXOFRAME** or **IRONKIN STEELJACKS** models.

As the step in which you Declare Battle Formations begins, you can pick a **HEARTHKYN WARRIORS** unit of yours that has never been split, and divide it into 2 units as near equal in size as possible, noting which models form each. Then:

- one of the 2 must begin the battle embarked in this **TRANSPORT**
- the remaining one can begin embarked in another **TRANSPORT**, or be deployed on its own

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
